title: Introduction to Cloud Computing
src: Source: Lecture 02 Introduction to Cloud Computing (45 slides). Community cloud comes from Lecture 01.
lead: Lecture 02: big data and the 5 V's, the electricity analogy, the cloud definition and NIST's five characteristics, IaaS / PaaS / SaaS and other as-a-service models, public / private / hybrid / community / multi-cloud, virtualization and the enabling technologies, containers, Kubernetes, serverless, edge and fog, AI in the cloud, shared responsibility, Zero Trust, FinOps, compliance, green cloud, multi-cloud and DevOps.
